claim_under_test: 'non-inertial quasi-static regime in which the stresses scale purely elastically' <=> A := tau*/kappa = tau d/k_n saturates to a constant

predictions.statement: A saturates: spread of A over kappa >= 2.3e4 is < 15%
predictions.rule: max(A)/min(A) - 1 <= 0.15 for gated R3 points with kappa >= 2.3e4

predictions.statement: the extrapolated A_inf lies within 15% of the stiffest gated point
predictions.rule: |A_inf - A(kappa_max)|/A(kappa_max) <= 0.15, fit A = A_inf + c kappa^-g

predictions.statement: the factored structural identity reproduces the normal-force A
the two geometric constants are concentration independent
predictions.rule: relative spread of a_xy and of f_norm over the 3 concentrations <= 0.15

predictions.statement: those constants predict the R2 map's total shear stress out of sample
predictions.rule: |A_pred/A_meas - 1| <= 0.15 on every gated R2 point with phi >= 0.71

honesty_rules: a rejected (ungated) point is reported, never re-run until it passes
no coefficient is compared to Campbell's table: it stays WITHHELD (paywalled)
if P3-P5 fail the factorisation is reported as FAIL and not refitted
